description.value: Sushi Ryu is a fusion Japanese restaurant in north Nanaimo that has been serving the neighbourhood since 2014. The menu spans sushi rolls, sashimi, donburi, and bento sets, with dedicated vegetarian and gluten-free options built into the menu rather than treated as afterthoughts. Both dine-in and takeout are available, supported by an online ordering system.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business name, address (6595 Applecross Rd, Nanaimo, BC V9V 1K8), and phone number, all matching OSM. The site explicitly advertises 'DINE IN/TAKE OUT 7 DAYS A WEEK' and online ordering, and the menu includes a dedicated Gluten Free Bento and Veggie Bento, corroborating OSM diet tags. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or any cyclist-specific infrastructure appears on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website and consistent contact details across OSM and site. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists, with vegetarian and gluten-free menu options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Veggie Bento (Veggie Roll & Tofu Teriyaki) and a dedicated Gluten Free Bento with gluten-free teriyaki sauce. OSM confirms
